emails.body:

OM Happy Teeth provides world-class dental treatment in Pimple Saudagar, and maintaining high patient attendance is vital for your practice.

I founded a clinic software startup that helped 12 clinics reduce appointment no-shows by a third using WhatsApp reminders. This simple tool improved patient communication without adding complexity.

Could you connect me with the person responsible for clinic operations or patient communications to discuss if this solution might help your clinic? I am happy to schedule a brief call at your convenience.

Best regards,
Test Founder
